research_question: Does rejection back into a prior-only 24-hour volume-profile value area, followed by a separate confirmation toward the point of control, produce stable cost-positive day trades?

reused: value is estimated from a completed prior auction rather than current outcome
an outside close is only an interaction, not an entry
reentry and a later confirmation toward POC are separate state transitions
the target and invalidation remain within the same failed-auction leg

scenario.context: a 24-hour profile from the prior 48 completed thirty-minute bars defines POC and a seventy-percent value area
scenario.interaction: a completed thirty-minute bar closes beyond VAH or VAL by at least fifteen percent of prior ATR with above-prior-median quote volume

state.HIGH_VALUE_REJECTION_TO_POC: the next completed thirty-minute bar closes back below the frozen VAH with bearish body and taker pressure
state.LOW_VALUE_REJECTION_TO_POC: the next completed thirty-minute bar closes back above the frozen VAL with bullish body and taker pressure

scenario.confirmation: the next completed fifteen-minute bar continues from reentry toward the frozen POC with directional body and taker pressure
scenario.invalidation: beyond the outside-event extreme plus ten percent of prior ATR
scenario.management: target or stop first; otherwise exit after six hours
scenario.arbitration: one global open position; choose the larger normalized outside excursion

data.source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly and latest daily five-minute klines
data.visibility: the profile is frozen before the outside event; reentry is a later completed 30-minute bar; entry follows a still later completed 15-minute bar

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per calendar day

decision_contract.advance: Only a fixed high or low rejection route positive in every declared split advances to NautilusTrader.
decision_contract.reject: Do not tune bins, value-area fraction, excursion, reentry, confirmation, stop or target rules after evaluation.
